item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-9776a6c1af4fb87b","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"In a September 2022 UN address, Tshisekedi stated that he had pursued reconciliation with neighboring states through permanent consultations, security-cooperation agreements, economic partnerships, and joint development projects, while supporting the Nairobi and Luanda peace processes and deployment of the East African regional force.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.7","8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Pre-period statement of intended policy relevant to 2023; implementation and outcomes in 2023 are not established by this source.","ruler_attribution":"Direct presidential speech; claims are self-reported.","limitations":["The address was delivered in 2022, not during the target year.","It does not independently verify implementation or effectiveness."]},{"source_id":"SRC-9776a6c1af4fb87b","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"Tshisekedi publicly attributed the eastern conflict to neighboring-state aggression and called for M23 withdrawal, return of displaced people, cessation of external support, continued Nairobi and Luanda negotiations, regional-force deployment, and restructuring of the Congolese armed forces.","question_ids":["2B.3","2B.7","2B.9","8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Pre-period policy position with relevance to the 2023 conflict; no 2023 implementation result is shown.","ruler_attribution":"Direct presidential speech; attribution of responsibility is his official position.","limitations":["The source presents the government's allegations and requested actions, not an independent adjudication of all claims.","The speech does not establish whether the proposed measures were implemented or durable."]},{"source_id":"SRC-9776a6c1af4fb87b","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"Tshisekedi stated that Congolese law prohibits and severely sanctions tribal, ethnic, racial, and xenophobic hate speech, and said the state and civil society would not permit such discourse.","question_ids":["3B.3","3B.8","4B.3","4B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Pre-period legal and rhetorical commitment relevant to 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Direct presidential speech describing applicable law and his stated position.","limitations":["The source does not document enforcement, sanctions, or remedies during 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-224b587ab58a058a","start_unit":16,"end_unit":17,"fact_summary":"A UN briefing reported that fighting involving M23 and other armed groups caused hundreds of thousands to flee in North Kivu, South Kivu, and Ituri; clashes between M23 and FARDC alone forced about 900,000 people from their homes in North Kivu, while humanitarian needs continued to increase.","question_ids":["2B.10","3B.6","3B.7","3B.10","6B.6","6B.10","8B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly relevant to 2023; briefing dated 29 March 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Independent UN briefing describing conditions during Tshisekedi's administration; it does not attribute all violence directly to him.","limitations":["The figures concern conflict conditions and displacement, not a complete causal assessment of presidential policy.","The source does not provide a comparable beginning-of-period baseline."]},{"source_id":"SRC-224b587ab58a058a","start_unit":16,"end_unit":17,"fact_summary":"The UN briefing said MONUSCO supported the Congolese government through joint patrols, fire support, information and intelligence sharing, logistics, rapid redeployment, static units in Ituri, demining, medical evacuation, and protection for displaced populations, while urging the government to reinforce military and police deployments and pursue security-sector reform.","question_ids":["2B.4","2B.7","3B.2","3B.6","3B.9","8B.2","8B.3","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly relevant to 2023; briefing dated 29 March 2023.","ruler_attribution":"UN assessment of MONUSCO support and recommendations to the government; it does not establish that all measures were directed personally by Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The report identifies external UN actions alongside government responsibilities.","It records recommendations and operations, not comprehensive evidence of government compliance or outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-224b587ab58a058a","start_unit":17,"end_unit":17,"fact_summary":"The UN briefing reported that regional peace initiatives were pursuing Nairobi and Luanda processes, that M23 had withdrawn from some positions but still controlled large portions of Masisi, Rutshuru, and Nyiragongo in violation of the Luanda communiqué, and that DRC-Rwanda tensions created a severe risk of regional escalation.","question_ids":["2B.7","2B.10","8B.9","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly relevant to 2023; briefing dated 29 March 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Independent UN briefing; it describes regional conditions and processes rather than assigning all responsibility to Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The source does not establish the president's individual role in each regional decision.","The peace-process status is a snapshot rather than a final outcome."]},{"source_id":"SRC-224b587ab58a058a","start_unit":17,"end_unit":17,"fact_summary":"MONUSCO transported 126 tons of electoral material to North Kivu, South Kivu, and Ituri and supported electoral inclusiveness through engagement with prospective candidates and civil society; the UN briefing also recorded logistical and security obstacles, low trust among stakeholders, and an opposition call to boycott voter registration.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.3","4B.7","8B.3","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly relevant to preparations for the 20 December 2023 elections.","ruler_attribution":"Independent UN briefing; material concerns state elections and external logistical support, not solely presidential action.","limitations":["The source does not assess the final election result or whether the process was fully free and fair.","MONUSCO's support cannot be attributed to Tshisekedi personally."]},{"source_id":"SRC-224b587ab58a058a","start_unit":17,"end_unit":17,"fact_summary":"The UN briefing stated that the 24 March 2023 government reshuffle was intended to support implementation of the administration's programme and urged the new government to operationalize disarmament, demobilization, reintegration, security-sector reform, screening and vetting, and transitional-justice processes; it specifically warned against amnesty or army reintegration for persons responsible for serious human-rights violations.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","8B.2","8B.4","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly relevant to 2023; briefing dated 29 March 2023.","ruler_attribution":"UN briefing identifies the presidential reshuffle and recommendations to the new government.","limitations":["Most items are recommendations or processes under way, not verified completed actions.","The source does not establish the qualifications or performance of individual appointees."]},{"source_id":"SRC-224b587ab58a058a","start_unit":17,"end_unit":17,"fact_summary":"MONUSCO supported deployment of 174 police officers for the successful handover of Bendera camp to the Congolese National Police in February 2023, but the UN briefing warned that stronger Congolese security-force presence was needed to prevent protection gaps.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.6","3B.10","8B.5","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly relevant to 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Independent UN briefing; the operation involved MONUSCO and Congolese authorities.","limitations":["The reported success was localized and does not demonstrate nationwide security-sector effectiveness.","The warning indicates unresolved capacity limitations."]},{"source_id":"SRC-891a5473cd8992be","start_unit":3,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"The 2023 Journal Officiel index records a 2023 decree specifying collection and distribution of mining royalties, regulations on commercial mining-product export and nomenclature, creation of the General Mining Inspectorate, and the 2023 rules of procedure of the Superior Council of the Court of Auditors.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.5","5B.7","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly relevant formal institutional actions recorded for 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Official legal-publication index; the documents are state instruments, but the index does not establish personal presidential authorship or implementation.","limitations":["The supplied extract lists instruments but not their full text, enforcement, fiscal effects, or audit findings.","The Journal Officiel site describes itself as an unofficial publication."]},{"source_id":"SRC-891a5473cd8992be","start_unit":3,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"The 2023 Journal Officiel index records a September 2023 interministerial order governing the state's share of proceeds from carbon-credit sales and a February 2023 decree establishing procedures for transactions involving assets of state mining companies.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.5","5B.7","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly relevant formal actions recorded for 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Official legal-publication index; personal presidential direction and implementation are not established.","limitations":["The extract does not show the instruments' substantive safeguards, actual revenue collection, or distributional results.","The Journal Officiel site describes itself as an unofficial publication."]},{"source_id":"SRC-891a5473cd8992be","start_unit":3,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"The 2023 Journal Officiel index lists the 2023 budget law, legislation modifying civil aviation rules, and the 2023 appointment of members of the permanent multisectoral commission coordinating medical and scientific cannabis activities.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.3","5B.6","8B.2","8B.4"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Directly relevant formal records for 2023, but insufficient to establish outcomes.","ruler_attribution":"Official legal-publication index; individual presidential responsibility is not shown.","limitations":["The extract provides titles and dates only, without budget execution, appointee qualifications, or results.","The Journal Officiel site describes itself as an unofficial publication."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cd857299cf702ddf","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"A World Bank Country Economic Memorandum published on 27 October 2023 concluded that, under the existing macroeconomic framework, DRC growth would not translate into improved living conditions without ambitious reforms; it proposed diversification, mining and cassava value-chain development, regional trade integration, job creation, and poverty reduction.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.4","5B.7","5B.10","8B.1","8B.2","8B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly relevant external institutional finding published during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Independent World Bank assessment of national policy conditions; not a finding of personal presidential misconduct.","limitations":["The memorandum identifies reform needs and potential pathways, not a full evaluation of Tshisekedi's individual decisions.","It does not quantify 2023 implementation of the proposed reforms."]},{"source_id":"SRC-9ba86c277e10a08c","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"An OHCHR communications record reported 440 alleged victims of trafficking, including sexual exploitation or sexual slavery, child marriage, and forced marriage, in North Kivu, South Kivu, Ituri, Tanganyika, and Maniema during August 2023 to April 2024; 127 were identified as children and 313 as internally displaced persons, all listed as female.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.7","3B.10","6B.3","6B.6","6B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Includes August-December 2023 and extends into 2024.","ruler_attribution":"OHCHR record of allegations in conflict-affected provinces; it does not attribute the alleged crimes directly to Tshisekedi.","limitations":["These are allegations recorded in a communications procedure, not final judicial findings.","The record does not identify perpetrators, government response, or the exact 2023 subset."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5ac6ae3b0fceacfe","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"The government budget website provided downloadable 2023 expenditure and revenue budget PDFs dated 15 February 2023.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.3","5B.6","8B.2"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Directly relevant to the 2023 budget period.","ruler_attribution":"Government budget portal; the listing shows publication of budget documents.","limitations":["The supplied extract contains no budget amounts, allocations, execution data, or policy interpretation."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-570bf02463c07e5f","SRC-916ac6d83be857d4","SRC-168e2f48ac4f5e7c","SRC-46620cb03168bc9a","SRC-ce77ee6a70c3edbf","SRC-0cad14d1857c9891"],"batch_limitations":["The supplied World Bank country page is primarily updated for 2025-2026 and does not provide a reliable, ruler-attributable 2023 fact in the extracted units.","The CENI result pages supplied no election results; one page stated that delivery contents were unavailable.","The UN Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons page failed to load substantive content.","The UN Security Council press-statement record supplied bibliographic metadata only.","The Ministry of Health page supplied a 2026 surveillance page and no material 2023 finding.","The target period is 2023-2023; the 2022 presidential speech is retained only as explicitly labeled pre-period program/context evidence."]}
